summary.text: Captain of the Mysians beside Ennomus the augur in the Catalogue of Ships — a namesake of Chromis figures in Ovid's battles, but Homer fixes this man among the allied captains who sailed to Ilios.

story.text: Nestor's roll names Chromis and Ennomus co-captains of the Mysians. Apollodorus makes them sons of Arsinous among the allies who joined the Trojans.
When the battle turned about Patroclus' body, Hector heartened the tribes of allies and named Chromis among the captains he roused to stand against the Danaans.
